capabilities.title: Process Monthly Interest Credit
capabilities.records: Accounts, Batch Error Log, Transaction Ledger

requirements.heading: Restrict Account Status to allowed values
requirements.text: The database defines: account_status IN ('ACTIVE','DORMANT','CLOSED') (table Accounts). Constraint is ENABLED and VALIDATED — enforced by the database for all data.
requirements.formal: It is necessary that account_status IN ('ACTIVE','DORMANT','CLOSED').

requirements.heading: Validate Principal
requirements.text: When Principal IS NULL OR Principal <= 0, the system applies the corresponding handling.
requirements.formal: When p_principal IS NULL OR p_principal <= 0, it is obligatory that the system reject the operation with error -20001: Principal amount must be greater than zero..

requirements.heading: Validate Annual Rate
requirements.text: When Annual Rate IS NULL OR Annual Rate < 0, the system applies the corresponding handling.
requirements.formal: When p_annual_rate IS NULL OR p_annual_rate < 0, it is obligatory that the system reject the operation with error -20002: Interest rate cannot be negative..

requirements.heading: Validate Tenure Days
requirements.text: When Tenure Days IS NULL OR Tenure Days <= 0, the system applies the corresponding handling.
requirements.formal: When p_tenure_days IS NULL OR p_tenure_days <= 0, it is obligatory that the system reject the operation with error -20003: Tenure in days must be greater than zero..

requirements.heading: Validate Day Count Basis is 360
requirements.text: When Day Count Basis = '360', the system applies the corresponding handling.
requirements.formal: When p_day_count_basis = '360', it is obligatory that the system set Basis Days to 360.

requirements.heading: Apply default Day Count Basis handling
requirements.text: When none of the preceding Day Count Basis conditions hold, the system applies its default handling.
requirements.formal: When no preceding condition matched, it is obligatory that the system set Basis Days to 365.

requirements.heading: Validate Current Status is ACTIVE
requirements.text: When v_days_inactive > 365 AND v_current_status = 'ACTIVE', the system applies the corresponding handling.
requirements.formal: When v_days_inactive > 365 AND v_current_status = 'ACTIVE', it is obligatory that the system update accounts and set Result to 'Account Marked Dormant'.

requirements.heading: Validate Current Status is DORMANT
requirements.text: When v_days_inactive <= 365 AND v_current_status = 'DORMANT', the system applies the corresponding handling (ELSIF branch 1).
requirements.formal: When v_days_inactive <= 365 AND v_current_status = 'DORMANT', it is obligatory that the system update accounts and set Result to 'Account Reactivated'.

requirements.heading: Apply default Current Status handling
requirements.text: When none of the preceding Current Status conditions hold, the system applies its default handling.
requirements.formal: When no preceding condition matched, it is obligatory that the system set Result to 'No Status Change Required'.

requirements.heading: Report missing Accounts record
requirements.text: When the database reports NO_DATA_FOUND — the requested record does not exist or the query returned no row — the system responds with: Result := 'ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND'.
requirements.formal: When NO_DATA_FOUND, it is obligatory that the system Result := 'Account Not Found'.

requirements.heading: Enforce Minimum Balance Req for SAVINGS_REGULAR
requirements.text: When v_account_type = 'SAVINGS_REGULAR', Minimum Balance Req is 1000.
requirements.formal: When v_account_type = 'SAVINGS_REGULAR', it is obligatory that the system set Minimum Balance Req to 1000.

requirements.heading: Enforce Minimum Balance Req for SAVINGS_PREMIUM
requirements.text: When v_account_type = 'SAVINGS_PREMIUM', Minimum Balance Req is 10000.
requirements.formal: When v_account_type = 'SAVINGS_PREMIUM', it is obligatory that the system set Minimum Balance Req to 10000.

requirements.heading: Enforce Minimum Balance Req for SAVINGS_ZERO_BAL
requirements.text: When v_account_type = 'SAVINGS_ZERO_BAL', Minimum Balance Req is 0.
requirements.formal: When v_account_type = 'SAVINGS_ZERO_BAL', it is obligatory that the system set Minimum Balance Req to 0.

requirements.heading: Enforce Minimum Balance Req for CURRENT_REGULAR
requirements.text: When v_account_type = 'CURRENT_REGULAR', Minimum Balance Req is 5000.
requirements.formal: When v_account_type = 'CURRENT_REGULAR', it is obligatory that the system set Minimum Balance Req to 5000.

requirements.heading: Enforce Minimum Balance Req for CURRENT_PREMIUM
requirements.text: When v_account_type = 'CURRENT_PREMIUM', Minimum Balance Req is 25000.
requirements.formal: When v_account_type = 'CURRENT_PREMIUM', it is obligatory that the system set Minimum Balance Req to 25000.

requirements.heading: Enforce default Minimum Balance Req
requirements.text: When no other case matches, Minimum Balance Req defaults to 1000.
requirements.formal: When no preceding case matched, it is obligatory that the system default Minimum Balance Req to 1000.

requirements.heading: Enforce Current Balance at or above Minimum Balance Req
requirements.text: When v_current_balance >= v_min_balancReq, the system applies the corresponding handling.
requirements.formal: When v_current_balance >= v_min_balance_req, it is obligatory that the system set Shortfall Amount to 0 and set Penalty Amount to 0.

requirements.heading: Apply default Current Balance handling
requirements.text: When none of the preceding Current Balance conditions hold, the system applies its default handling.
requirements.formal: When no preceding condition matched, it is obligatory that the system set Shortfall Amount to Minimum Balance Req - Current Balance and set Penalty Amount to LEAST(500, GREATEST(50, ROUND(Shortfall Amount * 0.05, 2))).

requirements.heading: Report missing Accounts record
requirements.text: When the database reports NO_DATA_FOUND — the requested record does not exist or the query returned no row — the system responds with: Message := 'ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND'; Penalty Amount := NULL.
requirements.formal: When NO_DATA_FOUND, it is obligatory that the system Message := 'Account Not Found'; Penalty Amount := NULL.

requirements.heading: Restrict processing to eligible Accounts records
requirements.text: This process applies only to rows of Accounts where account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND account_type LIKE 'SAVINGS%'. Records outside this population are not processed. Defined by cursor c_savings_accounts in Process Monthly Interest Credit, line 17.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that only records where account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND account_type LIKE 'SAVINGS%' are processed.

requirements.heading: Enforce Balance below 100,000
requirements.text: When rec.balance < 100000, the system applies the corresponding handling.
requirements.formal: When rec.balance < 100000, it is obligatory that the system set Interest Rate to 3.0.

requirements.heading: Enforce Balance below 1,000,000
requirements.text: When rec.balance < 1000000, the system applies the corresponding handling (ELSIF branch 1).
requirements.formal: When rec.balance < 1000000, it is obligatory that the system set Interest Rate to 3.5.

requirements.heading: Enforce Balance below 10,000,000
requirements.text: When rec.balance < 10000000, the system applies the corresponding handling (ELSIF branch 2).
requirements.formal: When rec.balance < 10000000, it is obligatory that the system set Interest Rate to 4.0.

requirements.heading: Apply default Balance handling
requirements.text: When none of the preceding Balance conditions hold, the system applies its default handling.
requirements.formal: When no preceding condition matched, it is obligatory that the system set Interest Rate to 4.5.

requirements.heading: Validate Interest Amount above 0
requirements.text: When v_interest_amount > 0, the system applies the corresponding handling.
requirements.formal: When v_interest_amount > 0, it is obligatory that the system set New Balance to Balance + Interest Amount and update accounts.

requirements.heading: Isolate per-record failures from the batch
requirements.text: A failure while processing one record is recorded and the run continues; a single bad record must not abort the batch.
requirements.formal: When unhandled error on a single record, it is obligatory that the system record the failure and continue with the remaining records.

requirements.heading: Report run failure as error -20010
requirements.text: An unrecoverable failure rolls the run back and reports application error -20010 to the caller. Callers depend on this code.
requirements.formal: When unrecoverable failure -> -20010, it is obligatory that the system roll back the run and report application error -20010 to the caller.

requirements.heading: Validate Amount
requirements.text: The operation must not proceed when Amount IS NULL OR Amount <= 0. Violation raises Invalid Amount.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that the operation is rejected when p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0, raising e_invalid_amount.

requirements.heading: Validate From Account is To Account
requirements.text: When From Account = To Account, the system applies the corresponding handling.
requirements.formal: When p_from_account = p_to_account, it is obligatory that the system set Status to 'FAILED' and set Message to 'Source and destination accounts cannot be the same.'.

requirements.heading: Require the Accounts record for From Account to exist
requirements.text: The referenced row in Accounts must exist. If the lookup returns no data the operation is rejected and Account Not Found is raised.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that the operation is rejected unless row must exist in accounts, raising e_account_not_found.

requirements.heading: Validate From Status is ACTIVE
requirements.text: The operation must not proceed when v_from_status <> 'ACTIVE'. Violation raises Account Inactive.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that the operation is rejected when v_from_status <> 'ACTIVE', raising e_account_inactive.

requirements.heading: Require the Accounts record for To Account to exist
requirements.text: The referenced row in Accounts must exist. If the lookup returns no data the operation is rejected and Account Not Found is raised.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that the operation is rejected unless row must exist in accounts, raising e_account_not_found.

requirements.heading: Validate To Status is ACTIVE
requirements.text: The operation must not proceed when v_to_status <> 'ACTIVE'. Violation raises Account Inactive.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that the operation is rejected when v_to_status <> 'ACTIVE', raising e_account_inactive.

requirements.heading: Enforce From Balance at or above Amount
requirements.text: The operation must not proceed when v_from_balance < Amount. Violation raises Insufficient Balance.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that the operation is rejected when v_from_balance < p_amount, raising e_insufficient_balance.

requirements.heading: Enforce Amount
requirements.text: The operation must not proceed when (v_today_txn_total + Amount) > v_daily_limit. Violation raises Daily Limit Exceeded.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that the operation is rejected when (v_today_txn_total + p_amount) > v_daily_limit, raising e_daily_limit_exceeded.

requirements.heading: Determine Interest
requirements.text: Interest is derived as: v_interest := ROUND( (Principal * Annual Rate * Tenure Days) / (100 * v_basis_days), 2 ). It depends on Annual Rate, Principal, Tenure Days, Basis Days.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that this value is calculated as: v_interest := ROUND( (p_principal * p_annual_rate * p_tenure_days) / (100 * v_basis_days), 2 ).

requirements.heading: Determine Days Inactive
requirements.text: Days Inactive is derived as: v_days_inactive := As of Date - NVL(v_last_txn_date, As of Date - 9999). It depends on Account Number, Account Status, Last Transaction Date, Account Number.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that this value is calculated as: v_days_inactive := p_as_of_date - NVL(v_last_txn_date, p_as_of_date - 9999).

requirements.heading: Determine Penalty Amount
requirements.text: Penalty Amount is derived as: Penalty Amount := LEAST(500, GREATEST(50, ROUND(Shortfall Amount * 0.05, 2))). It depends on Account Number, Account Type, Balance, Current Premium.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that this value is calculated as: p_penalty_amount := LEAST(500, GREATEST(50, ROUND(p_shortfall_amount * 0.05, 2))).

requirements.heading: Determine Days In Month
requirements.text: Days In Month is derived as: v_days_in_month := EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(Run Date)). It depends on Day, Extract, Run Date.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that this value is calculated as: v_days_in_month := EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(p_run_date)).

requirements.heading: Determine Interest Amount
requirements.text: Interest Amount is derived as: v_interest_amount := ROUND( rec.balance * (v_interest_rate / 100) * (v_days_in_month / 365), 2 ). It depends on Balance, Day, Extract, Run Date.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that this value is calculated as: v_interest_amount := ROUND( rec.balance * (v_interest_rate / 100) * (v_days_in_month / 365), 2 ).

requirements.heading: Determine Today Transaction Total
requirements.text: Today Transaction Total is derived as: SELECT NVL(SUM(txn_amount), 0) INTO v_today_txn_total FROM Transaction Ledger WHERE account_number = From Account AND txn_type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND TRUNC(txn_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE). It depends on Account Number, From Account, Transfer Out, Transaction Amount.
requirements.formal: It is obligatory that this value is calculated as: SELECT NVL(SUM(txn_amount), 0) INTO v_today_txn_total FROM transaction_ledger WHERE account_number = p_from_account AND txn_type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND TRUNC(txn_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE).
